question: Does the post-hoc damping arm (prior -> refine E + RPIC strain-rate damping) hold up when the damping is NOT fitted on the evaluated object?

unseen_data_check.result: No unseen sequences exist in real_capture.zip.
unseen_data_check.evidence: dynamic/sequences/ holds exactly one file per object (bun/burger/dog/pig/potato: 0.json); videos_images and videos_masks hold 100 frames per camera = 5 objects x 20 frames, all of them already used; static/ holds only multi-view stills, masks and a COLMAP model of the objects at rest (no motion). videos_compress/ has 3 full-length compressed MP4s (frame ids up to ~32k) WITHOUT masks; finding other drops in them would need new segmentation and was not attempted (untrusted archive, time box; the bundled extract_video.py is never run).

arm_under_test.name: prior_refine_damp_loo
arm_under_test.damping: for object o and camera fold h: rpic = median of the rpic values fitted by the post-hoc arm (docs/v3v run2, data/v3v/sims/<obj>/refine_damp.json) on the OTHER 4 objects in the same fold h. Those values were fitted only on those objects' fit sets (2 training cameras x frames 0..9), so no data of object o enters the damping.
arm_under_test.expected_values_known_in_advance: fold-wise fitted rpic: bun 1.0, burger 0.5/0.5/0.625, dog 1.0, pig 1.0, potato 1.0, so the LOO median is 1.0 for every object and fold (stated before evaluation).
arm_under_test.E: compass search on log10 E/rho x 1000 from the prior, exactly as the pre-registered E-only refinement: step 0.5 decade, +/- poll, move on improvement, halve on failure, stop at step < 0.0625 or 12 simulations; objective 1 - mean mask IoU on the fit set (2 training cameras x frames 0..9); nu = predicted; bounds 2.0..6.5.
arm_under_test.everything_else: identical to docs/v3v/PROTOCOL.json (initial state, engine, colouring, rendering, metrics, folds, splits).

comparisons_frozen.class_mean: from the first run, unchanged (10^3.482, nu 0.278)
comparisons_frozen.global_constant_loo: from the first run, constants frozen (per object/fold grid choice already in docs/v3v/RESULTS.json twins.global_constant_loo_log10E_per_fold)

comparisons_frozen.also_listed_for_reference: prior_refine (pre-registered E-only) and prior_refine_damp (post hoc, damping fitted in-sample)

metrics_and_stats: held-out camera (frames 1..19) and future frames (10..19, all cams): mask IoU, PSNR, SSIM; future 3D: centroid, lowest point, Chamfer; mean over n = 5 objects, percentile bootstrap 95% CI over objects (10000 resamples), per-object sign counts.
limits_stated_in_advance: This is NOT a test on unseen data: the same 5 drops are re-used; it only removes the in-sample fitting of the damping value. The damping form itself (RPIC) was chosen after seeing the first-run results. n = 5.
